description: Get a model recommendation for a task type without running inference. Returns the best free model for the task, its strengths and speed tier, and a list of alternatives. Use this when an agent needs to select a model before committing to inference, or to surface model selection logic to a human. Free.

speed.description: true = prefer fastest model over most capable. Default false.

task.description: Description of the task — e.g. "summarize a financial document", "write Python code", "translate from French", "reason through a math problem".

name: compute.cost
